cover.coreProposition: Checkpoint durability and replay-chain integrity are separate properties: a retained delta checkpoint is reconstructable only when its seed, ordered writes, deterministic reducer identity and migration remain valid, so compaction and pruning should require explicit reconstructability proof rather than treating deletion as storage housekeeping.
cover.visualMetaphor: A small preserved checkpoint is suspended above an illuminated chain whose missing link blocks recovery
cover.semanticObject: A compact state capsule connected to ordered luminous history links and a seed anchor
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover emphasizing that the visible checkpoint depends on an intact hidden chain
